name: agent-orchestrator
description: Route durable coding plans through user-approved executor pools, monitor jobs, and require review evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Control durable coding plans with approved executor pools.
interface.longDescription: Codex turns one request into a durable plan, starts an all-project dashboard, presents installed CLI harnesses and models, locks execution to a user-approved pool, asks in chat and the dashboard before escalation, permits only an optional pre-approved Terra timeout fallback, and requires diff and test evidence before acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Turn this into a durable plan, show me the installed cheap executors, and ask me which models to allow before launching.
Use Astra to plan and review, lock implementation to my approved cheaper models, and never use Astra as an automatic executor.
Start the dashboard, show my plans and active jobs, and ask me in chat and the dashboard before any executor escalation.
